titulo: Quiz — When it is not to you
subtitulo: Five questions about what disappears and what is left
introPt: Two people settle a plan at full speed, and a traveller catches the shape of it.
cenario: A counter with a queue, and two friends deciding what happens next.

dialogo.es: さあ、わかんないなあ。もう遅いし。
dialogo.tts: さあ、わかんないなあ。もう遅いし。

dialogo.es: そろそろ行かなきゃ。八時過ぎたら何もないよ。
dialogo.pt: We've got to go soon. After eight there's nothing left.
dialogo.tts: そろそろ行かなきゃ。八時過ぎたら何もないよ。

dialogo.es: まあ、じゃあ行こっか。それで決まりね。
dialogo.pt: Well, shall we go then. That's settled.
dialogo.tts: まあ、じゃあ行こっか。それで決まりね。

dialogo.es: すみません、わかりませんでした。もっとゆっくりお願いします。
dialogo.pt: Sorry, I didn't understand. More slowly, please.
dialogo.tts: すみません、わかりませんでした。もっとゆっくりお願いします。

perguntas.pergunta: You hear wakannai. What was said?
perguntas.explica: Wakaranai loses its polite masen, then contracts to wakannai. Three sizes of one sentence, all ordinary.

perguntas.pergunta: Someone says sorosoro ikanakya. What has just happened?
perguntas.explica: Ikanakya is ikanakereba naranai worn down in speech. If it is aimed at your table, stand up.

perguntas.pergunta: What job does de at the front of a turn do?
opcoes: It introduces the consequence, usually the decision
It means suddenly and nothing else
perguntas.explica: Tune your ear to it: the useful half of the sentence tends to come right after.

perguntas.pergunta: Sore de kimari lands at the end of the exchange. What does it tell you?
opcoes: Something is about to be explained
That is settled — the rest is politeness
perguntas.explica: Sore de kimari marks the end of the part you needed.

perguntas.pergunta: Should you start saying wakannai and miteru yourself?
opcoes: Yes, it shows you are fluent
No — recognise it, produce the full form
Only with people your own age
perguntas.explica: This module is receptive on purpose. In a visitor's mouth it reads as an impression of Japanese rather than as Japanese.
